formal_statement: For fixed finite μA,μH,OA,OH,U,T,b,λ,r satisfying the stated mass and nonnegative-parameter premises, if r is strictly below the exact two-population certificate, then every p:I→ℝ with 0≤p≤1 and EμH[p(OH)]≤b has r<RμA(p).
